metadata.content:
*You fire a telepathic bolt empowered by every consciousness within reach directly into your foe's mind.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged), [Strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike), Telepathy** |     **[Main action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** |
| ------------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) 10**  | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Reason](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/reason):**

- **≤11:** 15 + R psychic damage
- **12-16:** 24 + R psychic damage
- **17+:** 28 + R psychic damage

**Effect:** This ability ignores [cover](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/cover) and [concealment](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/concealment).

**Strained:** The [ability roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/ability-roll) scores a [critical hit](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/critical-hit) on a natural 17 or higher. You take half the damage the target takes, and you can't reduce this damage in any way.
